4.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase and added speaker labels that are not in the KJV), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses. V4 keeps the KJV's circumcise yourselves to the LORD, explained in parentheses. V23 keeps without form, and void.

verses.text: If you will return, O Israel, says the LORD, return to Me. And if you will put away your abominations (hated idols) out of My sight, then shall you not remove (wander).
And you shall swear: The LORD lives, in truth, in judgment (justice), and in righteousness. And the nations shall bless themselves in Him, and in Him shall they glory.
For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: Break up your fallow ground (hard unplowed ground), and sow not among thorns.

Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart (give your hearts fully to the LORD), you men of Judah and inhabitants (people) of Jerusalem. Lest (or else) My fury come forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench (put out) it, because of the evil of your doings.
Declare in Judah, and publish (announce) in Jerusalem, and say: Blow the trumpet in the land. Cry, gather together, and say: Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced (walled) cities.
Set up the standard (flag) toward Zion. Retire (run for safety), stay not. For I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

The lion is come up from his thicket (bushes), and the destroyer of the Gentiles (nations) is on his way. He is gone forth (out) from his place to make your land desolate (empty). And your cities shall be laid waste (ruined), without an inhabitant (person living there).
For this gird you with sackcloth (put on rough cloth worn in sorrow), lament (mourn) and howl. For the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

And it shall come to pass at that day, says the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish (fail), and the heart of the princes (leaders). And the priests shall be astonished (shocked), and the prophets shall wonder.
Then said I (Jeremiah): Ah, Lord GOD! Surely You have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying: You shall have peace. Whereas the sword reaches to the soul.
At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem: A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness (desert) toward the daughter of My people, not to fan (separate grain), nor to cleanse,
Even a full wind from those places shall come to Me. Now also will I give sentence (judgment) against them.
Look, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind. His horses are swifter (faster) than eagles. Woe to us (we are in great trouble)! For we are spoiled (ruined).
O Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, so that you may be saved. How long shall your vain (empty) thoughts lodge (stay) within you?
For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes (announces) affliction (trouble) from mount Ephraim.
Make mention to the nations. Look, publish (announce) against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
As keepers of a field, are they against her round about, because she has been rebellious against Me, says the LORD.
Your way and your doings have procured (brought) these things to you. This is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reaches to your heart.

My bowels (deep inside), my bowels! I am pained at my very heart. My heart makes a noise in me. I cannot hold my peace (stay quiet), because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
Destruction upon destruction is cried. For the whole land is spoiled (ruined). Suddenly are my tents spoiled (ruined), and my curtains in a moment.
How long shall I see the standard (flag), and hear the sound of the trumpet?
For My people is foolish, they have not known Me. They are sottish (foolish) children, and they have none understanding. They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
I beheld (looked at) the earth, and, lo (look), it was without form, and void (empty). And I looked at the heavens, and they had no light.
I beheld (looked at) the mountains, and, lo (look), they trembled (shook), and all the hills moved lightly (back and forth).
I beheld (looked), and, lo (look), there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled (gone).
I beheld (looked), and, lo (look), the fruitful place was a wilderness (desert), and all the cities of it were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by His fierce anger.
For this is what the LORD has said: The whole land shall be desolate (empty). Yet will I not make a full end.
For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black. Because I have spoken it, I have purposed (decided) it, and will not repent (change My mind), neither will I turn back from it.

The whole city shall flee (run away) for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen (archers). They shall go into thickets (bushes), and climb up upon the rocks. Every city shall be forsaken (left), and not a man dwell (live) in it.

And when you are spoiled (ruined), what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with crimson (red), though you deck (dress) yourself with ornaments of gold, though you rent (paint) your face with painting, in vain (for nothing) shall you make yourself fair (beautiful). Your lovers will despise (hate) you. They will seek (want) your life.

For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail (giving birth), and the anguish (pain) as of her that brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewails (cries over) herself, that spreads her hands, saying: Woe is me now (I am in great trouble)! For my soul is wearied (faint) because of murderers.

6.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase and added speaker labels that are not in the KJV), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses. V16 keeps the KJV's ask for the old paths, where is the good way. V10 keeps their ear is uncircumcised, explained in parentheses.

verses.text: O you children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee (run) out of the middle of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem. For evil appears out of the north, and great destruction.
I have likened (compared) the daughter of Zion to a comely (lovely) and delicate woman.
The shepherds with their flocks shall come to her. They shall pitch (set up) their tents against her round about. They shall feed every one in his place.
Prepare war against her. Arise (get up), and let us go up at noon. Woe to us (too bad for us)! For the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
Arise (get up), and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

For this is what the LORD of hosts (armies) has said: Hew down (cut down) trees, and cast (build) a mount (dirt ramp) against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited (punished). She is wholly (completely) oppression (cruelty) in the middle of her.
As a fountain casts out (pours out) her waters, so she casts out (pours out) her wickedness. Violence and spoil (destruction) is heard in her. Before Me continually is grief and wounds.
Be instructed (take warning), O Jerusalem, lest (or else) My soul depart from you, lest (or else) I make you desolate (empty), a land not inhabited (with no one living there).
This is what the LORD of hosts (armies) says: They shall throughly glean (pick clean) the remnant (rest) of Israel as a vine. Turn back your hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

To whom shall I speak, and give warning, so that they may hear? Look, their ear is uncircumcised (closed), and they cannot hearken (listen). Look, the word of the LORD is to them a reproach (something to mock). They have no delight in it.

Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD. I am weary with holding in. I will pour it out upon the children abroad (in the street), and upon the assembly (group) of young men together. For even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged (old) with him that is full of days (very old).
And their houses shall be turned to others, with their fields and wives together. For I will stretch out My hand upon the inhabitants (people) of the land, says the LORD.
For from the least of them even to the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness (greed). And from the prophet even to the priest every one deals falsely (lies).
They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of My people slightly, saying: Peace, peace. When there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination (hateful things)? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall. At the time that I visit (punish) them they shall be cast down (thrown down), says the LORD.

This is what the LORD says: Stand in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk in it, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said: We will not walk in it.
Also I set watchmen (guards) over you, saying: Hearken (listen) to the sound of the trumpet. But they said: We will not hearken (listen).
Therefore hear, you nations, and know, O congregation (gathered people), what is among them.
Hear, O earth: Look, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened (listened) to My words, nor to My law, but rejected it.
To what purpose comes there to Me incense (sweet-smelling spice) from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet to Me.

Therefore this is what the LORD says: Look, I will lay stumblingblocks (things to trip over) before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them. The neighbour and his friend shall perish (die).
This is what the LORD says: Look, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides (far parts) of the earth.

They shall lay hold on bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. And they ride upon horses, set in array (lined up) as men for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
We have heard the fame (report) of it. Our hands wax feeble (grow weak). Anguish (great pain) has taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail (giving birth).
Go not forth (out) into the field, nor walk by the way. For the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.

O daughter of My people, gird you with sackcloth (put on rough cloth worn in sorrow), and wallow (roll) yourself in ashes. Make you mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation (crying). For the spoiler (destroyer) shall suddenly come upon us.
I have set you (Jeremiah) for a tower and a fortress among My people, so that you may know and try (test) their way.
They are all grievous revolters (stubborn rebels), walking with slanders (lies about others). They are brass (bronze) and iron. They are all corrupters (evil).
The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed (burned up) of the fire. The founder (metal worker) melts in vain (for nothing). For the wicked are not plucked away (separated out).
Reprobate (rejected) silver shall men call them, because the LORD has rejected them.

verses.text: At that time, says the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes (leaders), and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants (people) of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host (stars) of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought (looked to), and whom they have worshipped. They shall not be gathered, nor be buried. They shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue (rest) of those who remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places where I have driven them, says the LORD of hosts (armies).
Moreover (also) you shall say to them: This is what the LORD says: Shall they fall, and not arise (get up)? Shall he turn away, and not return?
Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back (turned away) by a perpetual (constant) backsliding (turning away)? They hold fast deceit (lies), they refuse to return.

I hearkened (listened) and heard, but they spoke not aright (rightly). No man repented (was sorry) of his wickedness, saying: What have I done? Every one turned to his course (way), as the horse rushes into the battle.

Yes, the stork in the heaven knows her appointed times. And the turtle (turtledove) and the crane and the swallow observe (know) the time of their coming. But My people know not the judgment (law) of the LORD.
How do you say: We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo (look), certainly in vain (for nothing) made he it. The pen of the scribes (writers) is in vain (for nothing).
The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed (afraid) and taken. Lo (look), they have rejected the word of the LORD. And what wisdom is in them?

Therefore will I give their wives to others, and their fields to those who shall inherit (own) them. For every one from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness (greed). From the prophet even to the priest every one deals falsely (lies).
For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of My people slightly, saying: Peace, peace. When there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination (hateful things)? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore shall they fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation (punishment) they shall be cast down (thrown down), says the LORD.

I will surely consume (destroy) them, says the LORD. There shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade. And the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced (walled) cities, and let us be silent there. For the LORD our God has put us to silence, and given us water of gall (bitter poison) to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
We looked for peace, but no good came. And for a time of health, and look, trouble!

The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan. The whole land trembled (shook) at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones. For they are come, and have devoured (eaten up) the land, and all that is in it, the city, and those who dwell (live) in it.
For, look, I will send serpents (snakes), cockatrices (poisonous snakes), among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, says the LORD.
When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

Look, the voice of the cry of the daughter of My people because of them that dwell (live) in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? Is not her King in her? Why have they provoked (angered) Me to anger with their graven images (carved idols), and with strange vanities (empty foreign idols)?
The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
For the hurt of the daughter of My people am I hurt. I am black (in deep mourning). Astonishment (shock) has taken hold on me.
Is there no balm (healing ointment) in Gilead? Is there no physician (doctor) there? Why then is not the health of the daughter of My people recovered?
